notes: Removed the legacy FEHA_CAMERA_FEEDS.js implementation and its PointVisionSource POV/feed stack
Removed legacy Camera PLACE_FEED and VIEW_FEED capabilities from Network Devices and Device Actions
Removed all experimental JACK IN camera authoring layers, mode state, click capture code, camera feed status UI, and camera-specific placement CSS
Camera Network Devices remain a generic device type with DC 11 endpoint security and no camera-specific capabilities in the 0.10.0 baseline
Added isolated FEHA_CAMERA_PLACEMENT.js: GM CAMERA opens a dedicated full-screen Scene-image placement overlay outside JACK IN
The clean placement overlay has exactly two interactions: CANCEL and one click on the Scene image to create a Camera
JACK IN now only launches the camera placement module; camera placement mechanics no longer live inside FEHA_TABLETOP_UI_V3.js
RMB JACK IN panning keeps the always-available overscan bounds introduced during 0.9.x stabilization
knownLimitations: Camera 0.10.0 is placement-only: no feeds, POV, rotation, camera-specific hacking capabilities, or feed persistence exist yet
The new camera placement overlay must be live-tested in Foundry 14.361 before any additional camera mechanics are restored
Turret ROTATE/FIRE still require a future turret adapter
Status effects and non-damage Quickhack secondary effects are still not yet Active Effects
Quickhack rules still use effectText parsing as a legacy bridge pending explicit schema migration
The dev loader remains GM-only; player-client multiplayer device testing requires the modular runtime to be loaded through the actual FEHA module or an equivalent player-safe dev bootstrap
